acceptedAnswer.text: Foreign investors should be aware of the Foreign Investment in Real Property Tax Act (FIRPTA), which may require withholding a portion of the sale proceeds when selling a U.S. property. Additionally, understanding visa requirements and local ownership laws is crucial. While Kelby Contreras is a real estate professional, not a legal advisor, they can connect foreign clients with experienced legal and tax professionals specializing in international real estate transactions in Florida.
